newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BankAmerica target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BankAmerica target raised.

text.p: Morgan Stanley & Co analyst Athur Soter said he raised his 12-month price target on BankAmerica Corp to $118 from $110 and raised earnings estimates for the second time in three weeks based on anticipated restructuring steps that should produce substantial cost savings.

The analyst said he raised his 1997 estimate to $8.50 per share from $8.45 and upped his 1998 estimate to $9.80 per share from $9.55. About three weeks ago he was using estimates of $8.30 per share for 1997 and $9.30 for 1998.
Soter said BankAmerica remains a strong buy recommendation at Morgan Stanley.

The analyst said three big categories for expected cost savings including a reduction in the number of retail branches, reduction of corporate staff support mostly at the corporate level but also at the business unit level, and a restructuring of operations in Europe and Japan to focus on the businesses there that are most profitable.
The analyst said he expects gross expense saves of $350 million in 1997 and $140 million additional in 1998.

Soter said BankAmerica's restructuring steps could come in the fourth quarter of 1996 or in the first quarter of 1997. He said while the steps are likely to require a big restructuring charge, his guess was that it will coincide with a gain on an initial public offering (IPO) of stock in a merchant credit card unit.
BankAmerica was up 3-3/8 to 101-1/8 in morning trade.
